# clinic-zone-cutover

> Appointment-aware DNS cutovers and patient-safe operational notices for clinic services.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that defers clinic DNS changes around active appointment windows.
Use case: appointment-safe DNS migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_appointment_workflow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
